blindReviewDeclaration: Fresh v2s-rooted reviewer reopened mandatory inputs, recomputed the 57-row mapping, and falsified scope, receipt, FK, denominator, ledger, and UI-prerequisite claims before comparing author material.
expectedBehavior: All 57 P-items map to serial packages with non-ambiguous post-change denominators.
Every write has exactly one generated server-owned capability requirement and server-derived first scope.
R-24 POST/DELETE are replay-safe without hidden-reference leakage.
Every package binds six denominators to actual owning sources with real red proof.
P4 derives an auditable call-path denominator before optimization.
P6/P3-D begin only after Dexter accepts required amendments.

findings.title: Write-operation denominator is inconsistent across P3-A and P3-B
findings.evidence: P3-A and P3-B each close all 20 business writes, while P3-B retires one R-24 PUT and adds POST plus DELETE. No frozen pre/post operation set or counting rule assigns the successor requirements once.
findings.risk: A new R-24 write can omit generated capability or first-scope proof while the 20-write exit claims closure.
findings.disposition: Block acceptance; freeze the post-change mutating-operation inventory, one-package ownership, and requirement/resolver/owner/red-fixture binding per entry.

findings.title: P3-B lacks an executable receipt-race and FK-conflict linearization design
findings.evidence: Current receipt services read by key before command then insert; absent rows cannot be locked. P3-B promises workspace-scoped concurrent replay and an immediate store(head_company_id,brand_id) FK but specifies neither insert-race catch/re-read/hash comparison nor conversion of concurrent FK failure to the hidden-reference-safe typed conflict.
findings.risk: Concurrent requests can return duplicate-key/raw constraint errors instead of replay or safe typed conflict.
findings.disposition: Block acceptance; specify one REQUIRED transaction protocol for receipt acquisition/race/hash/replay/FK translation and add same-key plus concurrent store-create/remove real-red proofs.

findings.title: Manifest does not bind six package-exit fields to declared owning sources
findings.evidence: Plan §2 assigns D1 memory, D2 P-items, D3 forbidden sources, D4 exits, D5 Journey/interaction, and D6 standards matrix; every manifest denominator instead binds the same plan §2 anchor with CURRENT_MANIFEST_BYTES. The checker accepts a non-empty anchor and has no wrong-owning-source red fixture.
findings.risk: Package exit can prove only a self-referential summary, not memory, P-item, UI-surface, or due-standard closure.
findings.disposition: Block acceptance; bind real source paths/selectors/hashes and add red mutations for omitted memory assertion, P-item, UI surface, and R5 due rule.

findings.title: P4 canonical ledger has no independently bounded scanner contract
findings.evidence: P4-A demands exact scan set and deletion-of-ledger-row red proof but defines no scan roots, call-path identity, exclusions, extraction method, or relation to P4-B–F denominators.
findings.risk: An omitted N+1 path can still yield an apparently exact ledger.
findings.disposition: Define ledger schema, roots, classification, exclusions and an inserted production-path red mutation before implementation.

findings.title: P6/P3-D prerequisite amendments are not frozen implementation inputs
findings.evidence: The plan requires future amendments and Dexter acceptance for OTP, invitation retirement, group-workspace actions, work-context, and R-24 UI, but supplies neither amendment IDs/artifact bindings nor a re-freeze rule for U09/U10.
findings.risk: Later UX decisions can change task/state/readback/test obligations without reopening implementation-facing packages.
findings.disposition: Keep U09/U10 blocked; add amendment IDs, accepted artifact bindings, and manifest/design re-freeze before either begins.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The remediation targets real systemic risks; its serial topology and 57-row mapping are directionally appropriate.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Freeze post-change write/UI inventories, one receipt/FK race protocol, and real source denominators rather than adding generic platform machinery.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: These localized design repairs are proportionate; current self-referential controls would add ceremony without proving closure.

conclusion.summary: Round 1 confirms 57 mapped P-items and intended serial topology, but rejects acceptance for ambiguous post-R-24 write denominator, missing P3-B race protocol, self-referential six-field denominators, and unfrozen P4/P6 prerequisites.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This DESIGN review grants no implementation, contract, migration, runtime, seed/reset, test, or dynamic-environment authority.
